description: Multi-wave ensemble eval: clone repo, run Wave 1, optionally Wave 2, combine all scores

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
Wave 1 — 并行评估
commands.description: Run Wave 1 models in parallel, save per-model scores to scores/
commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE={mind_size} MIND_ROOT={data_root} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} KEEP_SCORES_DIR={output_root}/{output_subdir}/scores OUTPUT_FILE={output_root}/{output_subdir}/wave1_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise_ensemble.sh {wave1_model_paths}

commands.name: Wave 2 — 并行评估（可选）
commands.description: Run Wave 2 models if provided. Skipped if wave2_models is empty.
commands.command: if [ -n "{wave2_model_paths}" ]; then CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE={mind_size} MIND_ROOT={data_root} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} KEEP_SCORES_DIR={output_root}/{output_subdir}/scores OUTPUT_FILE={output_root}/{output_subdir}/wave2_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise_ensemble.sh {wave2_model_paths}; else echo 'Wave 2 skipped (no models provided)'; fi

commands.name: 合并所有分数 — 最终 Ensemble
commands.description: Average scores from all waves and compute final metrics

commands.name: 转换为 Leaderboard 格式（可选）
commands.description: Convert predictions to MIND leaderboard [rank1,rank2,...] format. Only useful for test split.
commands.command: if [ "{run_convert}" = "1" ]; then python src/convert_to_leaderboard_format.py --predictions {output_root}/{output_subdir}/ensemble_predictions.txt --behaviors {data_root}/{split}/behaviors.tsv --output {output_root}/{output_subdir}/leaderboard_submission.txt && echo 'Submission file: {output_root}/{output_subdir}/leaderboard_submission.txt'; else echo 'Leaderboard conversion skipped (run_convert=0)'; fi

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行 ===' && sleep infinity
